title: 番外假如朔衡变成反派6番外假如朔衡变成反派5
slug: 大千世界今日吾逍遥也
content_zh:
“好吧，看来你已经十分清楚他们的想法了。”
夏裕岚耸耸肩，一屁股坐回软榻上，“那就来聊点正事吧，比如…我们之间的合作？
你之前为什么拒绝我？”
“空手套白狼的招数，夏兄说出来可没什么诚意。
平白无故的从我这里套走一九分的分成，就算是梧桐神树真身上的一片叶子，也足够你们百宝商行赚得盆满钵满。”
朔衡笑了笑，“但是……夏兄，你能给我带来什么呢？
资源？还是灵石？”
夏裕岚恍然大悟的笑了
“怪我怪我。身为合格的商人，怎么能让合作者怀疑我的诚意呢？
为了表明我的诚意——
朔兄，你提个条件吧，我要是我能做主的，一定满足你！”
朔衡伸出两根手指。
“啥意思？比个耶？”
“两个条件。”
“嘶……”夏裕岚觉得跟朔衡聊天，他吸冷空气的次数好像有点多，“行吧，你先说说看？”
“第一，找出一条能顺利撤离梧桐小世界的路。”朔衡毫不畏惧的与他对视，“如果凤凰族真敢动手，那我不介意…给他们点教训。
所以，我需要一条可以安全离开的退路。
第二，我要神树空间内部最详细的资料，包括其中的考验、存在哪些怪物、共有几个区域，以及…
你口中所说，凤凰族特有的宝物到底是什么？”
“哎呀…小妹那家伙说的话果然没错。”

夏裕岚耸耸肩，“想从朔兄手里捞点好处，还真是不容易。
按理说，百宝商行保持中立，你和凤凰族之间的龌龊我们不便插手…不过谁让你是我和小妹都看好的人呢？
只有一点，假如朔兄真的被抓到了，可千万不要把我们百宝商行给供出去啊~”
夏裕岚嘴上说着“被抓到了”，实则面上的笑意仍然轻松自在，
好像完全没有把失败的可能性放在眼里——
换句话说，他对百宝商行的情报网有足够的信心。
“今日出了这扇百宝商行的门，我便只是个为了雷纹螺而来的客人。”
“好，朔兄爽快！”
夏裕岚高兴的拍拍手，“那就这么说定了。”
他说着，拿出一枚玉简，以及一块特殊的令牌：“这枚玉简记录了这么多年来我们从神树空间得到了绝大部分资料，还有些……朔兄懂得，商业机密嘛，那就是另外的价钱了。
不过那部分东西对朔兄来说用处也不大，基本上所有你想要的信息，这里都有。
至于这枚令牌，那是我们百宝商行为了方便运货，专门在梧桐小世界里开辟的特殊路径，
能直接通过空间传送，前往朝天城。”
朔衡拿起那块令牌，神色间带着一丝好奇和质疑：“听凰道友说，梧桐小世界的空间壁垒极为坚韧。”
“害，天下哪有我们百宝商行钻不进去的……咳咳，
总之就是，对于大多数修士来说，梧桐小世界确实只能通过正规途径进入，但谁让我们百宝商行的现任行主，也就是我的父亲——是一位货真价实的真我境强者呢？”
真我境？
朔衡敛眸。
仙人境之上的登神三步，星河、人间、真我，
百宝商行的底蕴果然恐怖，不愧是发展了无数纪元的大势力。
content_en:
"Well, it seems you already know what they think."
Xia Yulan shrugged and sat back on the soft couch, "Then let's talk about something serious, such as... our cooperation?
Why did you reject me before? "
"Brother Xia doesn't have any sincerity in saying this trick.
You took away 19 points from me for no reason. Even a leaf from the sacred sycamore tree is enough for your Baobao Trading Company to make a lot of money. "
Shuo Heng smiled, "But...Brother Xia, what can you bring me?
Resources? Or a spiritual stone? "
Xia Yulan suddenly realized and smiled.
"I blame me. As a qualified businessman, how can I let my collaborators doubt my sincerity?
To show my sincerity——
Brother Shuo, please make a condition. If I can make the decision, I will definitely satisfy you! "
Shuo Heng stretched out two fingers.
"What do you mean? Comparing?"
"Two conditions."
"Hiss..." Xia Yulan felt that while chatting with Shuo Heng, he seemed to be breathing in the cold air too much. "Okay, can you talk about it first?"
"First, find a way to escape Wutong Little World smoothly." Shuo Heng looked at him without fear, "If the Phoenix Clan really dares to take action, then I don't mind... teaching them a lesson.
So, I needed a way out safely.
Second, I want the most detailed information inside the Divine Tree space, including the tests, what monsters exist, how many areas there are, and...
What are the unique treasures of the Phoenix Clan you said? "
"Oh...what that guy said is indeed true."
Xia Yulan shrugged, "It's really not easy to get some benefits from Brother Shuo.
It stands to reason that Baibao Trading Co., Ltd. remains neutral, and we cannot interfere in the turmoil between you and the Phoenix Clan... But who makes you the person that both my little sister and I like?
The only thing is, if Brother Shuo is really caught, please don’t expose our Baibao Trading Company~”
Xia Yulan said "got caught", but in fact the smile on his face was still relaxed and relaxed.
It seems that the possibility of failure is completely ignored——
In other words, he has enough confidence in the intelligence network of Baibao Trading Company.
"When I walked out of this Baobao Trading House today, I was just a customer here for the thunder-threaded snail."
"Okay, Brother Shuo, feel free!"
Xia Yulan clapped her hands happily, "Then it's settled."
As he spoke, he took out a jade slip and a special token: "This jade slip records most of the information we have obtained from the Divine Tree Space over the years, and some... Brother Shuo understands that commercial secrets have another price.
But those things are of little use to Brother Shuo. Basically all the information you want is available here.
As for this token, it is a special path opened by our Baibao Trading Company in the small world of Wutong in order to facilitate the transportation of goods.
Can be teleported directly through space to Chaotian City. "
Shuo Heng picked up the token with a hint of curiosity and doubt in his expression: "I heard from fellow Taoist Huang that the space barrier in Wutong Little World is extremely tough."
"Hate, there is no place in the world that our Baobao Trading Company can't get into... Ahem,
In short, for most monks, it is true that Wutong Small World can only be entered through formal channels, but who made the current owner of our Baibao Trading Company, my father, a genuine True Self Realm powerhouse? "
Real self state?
Shuo Heng narrowed his eyes.
The three steps above the immortal realm, the galaxy, the human world, and the true self.
The background of Baibao Trading Company is indeed terrifying, and it is worthy of being a powerful force that has developed for countless epochs.
